sources.snippet: Speaker Verification with ECAPA-TDNN embeddings on Voxceleb This repository provides all the necessary tools to perform speaker verification with a pretrained ECAPA-TDNN model using SpeechBrain. The system can be used to extract speaker embeddings as well. It is trained on Voxceleb 1+ Voxceleb2 training data. For a better experience, we encourage you to learn more about SpeechBrain.
